codex-0-147-portable-plugins-auto-approv.title: Codex 0.147.0: Portable Plugins, Automatically Approved Reviews, and Safer Defaults
codex-0-147-portable-plugins-auto-approv.description: OpenAI's newest stable Codex lets you install plugins from anywhere, auto-approve low-risk commands, and imports your Cursor skills with safer permissions. A beginner-friendly walkthrough.

qwen3-8-max-2-4t-autonomous-coding-open-.title: Qwen3.8-Max Ships With 2.4T Parameters, 16-Day Autonomous Coding Demo, and Open Weights Coming Next Week
qwen3-8-max-2-4t-autonomous-coding-open-.description: Alibaba's Qwen3.8-Max runs autonomous coding projects for 16 days straight, beats Claude Opus 4.8 on Terminal Bench, and will open-source its weights — but every benchmark number is vendor-run.

beware-claude-code-nested-project-sandbo.title: Beware: Claude Code Silently Drops Its Sandbox in Nested Project Folders
beware-claude-code-nested-project-sandbo.description: Claude Code issue #83035: when a session or subagent runs inside a nested project directory, the workspace's sandbox settings are silently discarded — network restrictions and unsandboxed-command policies stop applying. No warning, no error. Here's how to check if you're affected.

deepagents-code-approval-modes-guide.title: Deep Agents Code (dcode) Approval Modes: Manual, Auto, YOLO — The Practical Guide
deepagents-code-approval-modes-guide.description: LangChain's terminal agent dcode has exactly three approval modes: Manual, classifier-backed Auto, and YOLO. Here's what each gates, how to enable them, how the Auto classifier works, and when each mode is safe to run.

hermes-agent-v020-herald-voice-a2a-webho.title: Hermes Agent v0.20.0 (Herald): Voice That Interrupts, A2A Agent Chat, and Webhooks — Beginner's Guide
hermes-agent-v020-herald-voice-a2a-webho.description: Hermes Agent v0.20.0, the Herald release, adds streaming hands-free voice with barge-in, Agent-to-Agent (A2A v1.0) interop, signed outbound webhooks, grounded citations, and a desktop plugin SDK. Plain-English breakdown for beginners.

hn-agent-approval-fatigue-humans-in-the-.title: What Developers Think About Approving Every AI Agent Command — From 177 HN Comments
hn-agent-approval-fatigue-humans-in-the-.description: A browser game collected 409,000 real approval decisions from developers watching AI agents run commands. Humans missed 1 in 3 dangerous ones. The Hacker News debate that followed explains why 'just review the prompts' never worked.

hn-oracle-openjdk-ai-code-ban-hn-opinion.title: What Developers Think About Oracle Banning AI Code — From 470 HN Comments
hn-oracle-openjdk-ai-code-ban-hn-opinion.description: Oracle banned AI-generated code from OpenJDK while pouring billions into AI infrastructure. Hacker News responded with 470 comments on hypocrisy, licensing, and the real problem with AI slop in open source.

oh-my-pi-v17-hub-tool-xdev-plugins.title: Oh My Pi v17 Is Here: The Hub Tool, xd:// Virtual Files, and a Plugins Standard — What Changes for Beginners
oh-my-pi-v17-hub-tool-xdev-plugins.description: Oh My Pi's v17 series — from v17.0.0 on July 15 to v17.2.11 on August 7 — merges its messaging and job tools into one hub, replaces hidden tools with xd:// virtual files, and adds an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 standard. A plain-English guide to what changed and whether your setup is affected.

openclaw-v2026-6-34-safer-browser-networ.title: OpenClaw v2026.6.34: Your Coding Agent's Browser and Network Access Just Got Safer
openclaw-v2026-6-34-safer-browser-networ.description: OpenClaw's August 8 stable release sandboxes its browser, locks down DNS targets, patched the ip-address library behind CVE-2026-69192, and stops silent mid-task crashes. A plain-English walkthrough of what changed and how to update.

qwen-code-v0-21-8-trust-cache-fork-autof.title: Qwen Code v0.21.8 Fixes a Trust Bug, Shares Prompt Cache, and Brings Back Fork Autofix
qwen-code-v0-21-8-trust-cache-fork-autof.description: Qwen Code's August 8 release fixes a security issue where folders you marked untrusted could inherit trust from a parent directory, enables cache sharing for OpenAI/Gemini/Vertex to cut costs, and restores autofix for pull requests from forks. Plain-English breakdown for beginners.
